description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface and acts as a filter in a logging chain, passing only the message part to the next LogNode in the chain.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode implementation that filters logs to only pass the message content, useful for simplified log displays.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters the log message to only pass the message part to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
